parameters.name: Filter
parameters.description: The field that is used for fuzzy matches. The system performs fuzzy matches only by service name.

parameters.name: GroupName
parameters.description: The name of the service group. For more information about how to query the name of a service group, see [ListServices](~~412109~~).

parameters.name: Label
parameters.description: The tag that is used to filter services.

parameters.name: Order
parameters.description:
The sorting order. Valid values:

*   desc (default): The query results are sorted in descending order.
*   asc: The query results are sorted in ascending order.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page. Default value: 100.

parameters.name: ParentServiceUid
parameters.description: The ID of the primary service that corresponds to the Band member service.

parameters.name: ResourceName
parameters.description: The name or ID of the resource group to which the service belongs.

parameters.name: Role
parameters.description:
The server role.

Valid values:

*   DataLoader
*   FrontEnd
*   DataSet
*   SDProxy
*   LLMSscheduler
*   ScalableJob
*   LLMGateway
*   Job
*   Queue

parameters.name: ServiceType
parameters.description:
The service type. Valid values:

*   Async
*   Standard
*   Offline Task
*   Proxima
